title: Authorization for Enlargements of Community Facility Buildings

blocks.html: Within the Special Ocean Parkway District, the City Planning Commission may authorize enlargements that exceed the bulk limitations of Section 113-11 (Special Bulk Regulations for Community Facilities), provided:
blocks.plainText: Within the Special Ocean Parkway District, the City Planning Commission may authorize enlargements that exceed the bulk limitations of Section 113-11 (Special Bulk Regulations for Community Facilities), provided:

blocks.html: (a)        the existing building is a community facility building developed prior to December 19, 1996;
blocks.plainText: (a) the existing building is a community facility building developed prior to December 19, 1996;

blocks.html: (b)        the existing community facility building is located partially or wholly on a corner lot, one lot line of which is the street line of a wide street;
blocks.plainText: (b) the existing community facility building is located partially or wholly on a corner lot, one lot line of which is the street line of a wide street;

blocks.html: (c)        the enlarged community facility building will comply with the bulk regulations of Article II, Chapter 4 (Bulk Regulations for Community Facilities in Residence Districts); and
blocks.plainText: (c) the enlarged community facility building will comply with the bulk regulations of Article II, Chapter 4 (Bulk Regulations for Community Facilities in Residence Districts); and

blocks.html: (d)        the scale of the proposed community facility building is appropriate to the scale of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: (d) the scale of the proposed community facility building is appropriate to the scale of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
